P0FFF.title: Not Documented - No Defined Meaning
P0FFF.description: P0FFF has no documented meaning. The published code lists for SAE J2012 end the P0 range at P0EFE, and the block P0F00 onward is held back by ISO and SAE as reserved. No vehicle maker, no regulator filing and no service bulletin in the NHTSA archive uses P0FFF. A meaning sometimes shown online belongs to a different code. If a scan tool reports P0FFF, the likely causes are a reading error, a tool with a faulty code table or a maker-specific code shown with the wrong prefix; check the raw data and the manufacturer's own code list.
